# VSG directive protocol (v1) - developer reference

Source of truth: `ui/src/protocol/directives.ts`. Argus-facing copy:
`hermes-skills/virtual-security-guard/references/directive-protocol.md`.

Blocks are fenced JSON with a `vsg-` language tag. The parser
(`protocol/parser.ts`, `parseAgentText`) splits a reply into text, directive,
pending (still streaming) and invalid segments; `lenientJson` tolerates common
model mistakes (trailing commas, smart quotes).

| Block | Direction | Purpose | Rendered by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vsg-context` | UI → Argus | Image URL and result limit, appended to search turns. Cameras and times come from the prompt text. | - |
| `vsg-matches` | Argus → UI | `keep` refs (`m<N>` = Nth hit of the same reply's tool result), notes. | `ValidationGrid` |
| `vsg-feedback` | UI → Argus | `confirm` / `reject` refs, labels, optional note. Unconfirmed shown matches are sent as `reject`. Only the latest grid can be sent; a repeat replaces its earlier verdicts. | operator bubble |
| `vsg-report` | Argus → UI | Incident report draft (title, preset, summary, timeline, actions, confidence). | `ReportCard` |
| `vsg-status` | Argus → UI | One-line status. | inline text |

## Run lifecycle

1. `investigation.ts` builds the input (`vsg-context` + text, or
   `vsg-feedback`) and per-run `instructions` (`protocol/instructions.ts`).
2. `POST /hermes/v1/runs` → stream `GET /hermes/v1/runs/:id/events` (SSE) →
   text deltas and tool events update the agent turn.
3. After the run, `ground()` reads `/hermes/api/sessions/:id/messages` and
   stores the run's `vss_search_video` result on the agent turn
   (`groundingForRun`); a failed read sets `groundError` and the grid offers
   Retry (`reground`).
4. After the run the camera list is refreshed. The store never starts a live
   search; only the route card's button does (`startWatch`).

## Session sightings

`useInvestigationStore.reviews` holds each grid's working and sent verdicts,
keyed by the agent turn id; only the latest grid (`latestGridId`) can change.
`confirmedSightings` (`stores/case.ts`) walks the grids' **sent** verdicts in
turn order (a later grid's verdict on the same `segmentKey` wins), adds the
confirmed live sightings from the live timeline (`stores/liveTimeline.ts`, one
stop per sighting at its start), and sorts by `hitTime`.
`routeOf` / `useRoute()` turn that into the route. `investigation.ts` sends them with every run via
`buildInstructions({ sightings: timelineLines(...) })` as numbered lines
(`N. <ISO time> <camera> (ref video_id@start, score) ; moved from X in 3 min
05 s`). Argus uses those refs as `vsg-report.timeline[].ref`; `hitMatchesRef`
matches them to PDF rows. The PDF adds a Movement section from
`movementLegs`. Past reports are regenerated by resuming the session.

## Live search

- Started only by the operator, from the route card button. The UI uses the
  current subject (latest searched image, else latest search prompt):
  `POST /vss/manager/search` + `PATCH /vss/manager/search/:id/watch`. Argus
  never calls `vss_watch_search`.
- Polls `GET /vss/manager/search/:id` every 10 s (`POLL_MS` in
  `stores/watch.ts`). Hits fold into per-camera sightings (60 s gap,
  `SIGHTING_GAP_MS`) in `stores/liveTimeline.ts`, shown as a timeline. The
  timeline is saved per Hermes session in browser storage (last 20 sessions)
  and stays read-only after the watch ends.
- Confirming a live sighting adds it to the route; there is no reject. The
  map changes only on confirm.
- Stops on operator Stop, the time limit (`watchMinutes`) or no new matches
  (`watchIdleMinutes`).
- Other `vsg-*` fences (such as the retired `vsg-track`) are dropped by the
  parser.
